font_stack: Space Grotesk 700 / IBM Plex Sans 400-600 / JetBrains Mono 400-700, loaded in frontend/index.html
palette: OKLCH custom properties in frontend/tokens.css (anchor hue 256, dark paper L14%)
motion: no motion library - CSS transitions only, named easings in tokens.css
notes: Severity scale is data encoding, not accent colour. It is mirrored in data/config/risk_weights.json and must stay in sync with the --status-* tokens.
Leaflet runs with preferCanvas and Recharts writes SVG attributes; neither resolves var(). Both read computed values via src/hooks/useDesignTokens.ts - that is the only sanctioned place to do so.
Stated deviation: UI chrome floors at 12px for operational density; all prose is >= 16px.
